label: early input step 1-2 positions after a 3 or t
explanation: Fires during the original-input phase (94% of mass; 6% on the <DEL> step, almost never in copy), mostly at t=1..5 (peaks t=2-3), on the one or two steps right after the digit 3 or letter t was input (prev_tok 3: 9.2x lift, t: 8.0x; prev2_tok 3/t: 7.2x/5.1x); p is a weaker trigger (2.4x). Strongest activations come right after repeated 3s early in the sequence (e.g. p 3 3 X, 3 3 X, t 3 3 X). It does not fire at t=0, rarely at t>=6, and almost never in the copy phase. Predicate covers ~99% of the top two activation quartiles, but weak activations (bottom quartile) have only ~30% coverage, and some predicted steps stay silent.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the previous input (most: 3, t, p, c, v, x; least: a, w, 0, n) and the input two steps back (most: 3, t, p, v, c, 2; least: a, w, 0, n); timing cues that raise it most: t=4, t=3, t=2.
